variance_components.note: U = KL(n) - KL(0) over the 8 x 8 table; rows batches C1..C8, columns starts 1..8

design_table.rule: cheapest design with w40 <= 0.25 and w80 <= 0.25; n_s >= 5 where the start floor binds (sigma2_c > 0.1 x 2 sigma2_int / K at any budget, with the candidate's own K); else the smallest w80 under the author's cap. Reported; we apply the rule.

shuffle_noise_ratio.rule: keep 8 shuffles if the median is at most 0.1 at every budget and stage, else 16
shuffle_noise_ratio.sealed: only the ratio is reported; D and the shuffled means are not
